name: megascenes-photoshoot
description: Create photoshoot pictures of yourself from your own photo in your MegaScenes library: the same face in a new scene and outfit.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a selfie or a portrait of yourself from your MegaScenes library and describe the shoot: a city street at golden hour, a studio with a colored backdrop, a cafe, a beach walk in a linen shirt. You get a picture that keeps your face, in the scene and outfit you chose.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the shoot needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The picture opens in the chat and stays in your library next to your photo.

For profiles, portfolios, dating apps and social posts.

Limitations: only from your own photo or one of someone who agreed to it, never of a famous person; no swimwear, underwear or sensual shots. The photo must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Place you in a new scene and outfit
Return the photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a golden hour city photoshoot from my latest MegaScenes photo
Put me in a studio shoot with a blue backdrop
Create a cafe portrait of me in a denim jacket

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a golden hour city street photoshoot from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one photoshoot picture with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a photoshoot here?
positive.expected_behavior: The photoshoot models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a golden hour city street photoshoot of me in a denim jacket from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my photoshoot picture on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my photoshoot picture to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
